name: owasp-audit
description: Two OWASP security audit skills: owasp-agentic-audit (OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10, AST01–AST10) for AI agent skills, plugins and MCP servers, and owasp-app-audit (classic OWASP Top 10, A01–A10) for ordinary application code. Each writes a dated report with findings, severity, and suggested fixes.
